message: Fixed and verified. Settle up now leaves all balances at zero and everyone square.

plan.title: Lisbon trip $100 Dinner split 3 ways -> Settle up leaves $0.01 owed
plan.url: 127.0.0.1:5174 - address bar shows Lisbon trip - Tally / 127.0.0.1:5174 visible from 00:00.0 throughout
plan.expected: After Settle up creates the two suggested repayments Sam -> Alex $33.33 and Jo -> Alex $33.33 the balances should all be $0.00 - Alex is owed $0.00 / all participants owe nothing - fully settled. No 1 cent remainder.
plan.actual: After clicking Settle up the Balances panel still shows a residual balance: `Alex is owed $0.01` while `Sam owes nothing` and `Jo owes nothing`. Balances never reach zero / never show fully settled.

steps.instruction: Leave Paid by as Alex default - Split equally between everyone

before.evidence: Balances panel shows 'Alex is owed $0.01' while 'Sam owes nothing' and 'Jo owes nothing' after Settle up created two $33.33 payments for $100.00 Dinner

fix.root_cause: `splitEvenly` rounded every share with `Math.round`, so a $100 3-way split assigned $33.33 to all three members whose shares summed to $99.99, leaving a 1-cent residual on the payer.
fix.summary: Changed `splitEvenly` to use floor plus distributing the leftover cents one each to the first members so shares always sum to the full amount.
fix.message: Fixed by muse-code; tests pass and the regression test fails on the old code.

after.evidence: AFTER Balances panel shows 'Alex owes nothing', 'Sam owes nothing', 'Jo owes nothing' plus 'All settled up Everyone is square. Nice trip!' with expenses 'Jo paid Alex $33.33' and 'Sam paid Alex $33.33' - no 'is owed $0.01' residual vs BEFORE 'Alex is owed $0.01'.
